name: moodle-dev
description: Moodle development toolkit for scaffolding, reviewing, testing, securing, and upgrading plugins across Moodle 4.x and 5.x.

interface.longDescription: Develop Moodle plugins with guidance for scaffolding, XMLDB migrations, capabilities, web services, Hooks API, AMD JavaScript, PHPUnit, Behat, security, privacy, performance, accessibility, themes, mobile integration, and cross-version upgrades.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a Moodle plugin from this feature brief.
Review this Moodle plugin for security and privacy issues.
Upgrade this Moodle plugin to the latest supported release.
